
 Usage: houston pat [OPTIONS]

 Mint a Personal Access Token and print ready-to-use headers (curl/Postman).

╭─ Options ──╮
 --name        -n                     <str>
 --label                              <str>  token name shown in the admin UI [default: houston]
 --bypass-2fa      --no-bypass-2fa           create with "Ignore Two Factor Authentication"
                                             [default: bypass-2fa]
 --help                                      Show this message and exit.
╰──╯
